_comment: DO NOT EDIT: FILE GENERATED AUTOMATICALLY BY PTERODACTYL PANEL - PTERODACTYL.IO
author: echo@mia-hentschel.de
description: Echo VR dedicated server with nevr-runtime under Wine. Managed with evr-ptero (github.com/marshmallow-mia/pterodactyl_Echo_Server). Uses the node's shared game files by default; the game port must be forwarded 1:1 (same external and internal UDP port). Generated by evr-ptero dev.
name: Echo VR (nevr-runtime)

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Echo VR (nevr-runtime) installer. With GAME_SOURCE=mount nothing is copied:
# the node provides the game and runtime read-only at /opt/echovr.
set -euo pipefail
if [ "${GAME_SOURCE:-mount}" != "download" ]; then
  echo "Game files come from the node's shared mount (/opt/echovr). Nothing to install."
  exit 0
fi
evr-ptero files install --dir /mnt/server/echovr --runtime "${NEVR_VERSION:-current}"

variables.name: Discord ID
variables.description: Discord user ID of the EchoVRCE host account.

variables.name: Server password
variables.description: Password of the EchoVRCE host account. Only admins can see or change it. Required for nevr-runtime 6.x, which refuses a device link alone; leave empty only for a 5.x server on a device link (evr-ptero account link).

variables.name: Backend HTTP key
variables.description: http_key for the EchoVRCE backend. Empty uses the public key nevr-runtime embeds.

variables.name: Regions
variables.description: Comma-separated regions this server offers itself for, e.g. euw. Empty uses the backend's default.

variables.name: Guilds
variables.description: Comma-separated guild IDs to host for. Empty hosts for every guild the account may host.

variables.name: Empty server TTL
variables.description: Seconds an empty server waits before it returns to the lobby (0 = immediately).

variables.name: nevr-runtime version
variables.description: "current" follows the node's current runtime (updated by evr-ptero); or pin a tag like v6.6.0.

variables.name: Publisher lock
variables.description: Game publisher lock; the EchoVRCE backend expects echovrce.

variables.name: Game files
variables.description: "mount" uses the node's shared read-only files (/srv/echovr, set up by evr-ptero); "download" installs a private copy (about 5 GB) into this server.

variables.name: Console output
variables.description: "default" hides the runtime's noisy diagnostics, "all" shows everything.
